phase: Phase 1 - Canonical Mission Lifecycle and Run Control

run_control_architecture.defect_identified: Cached ApplicationRuntime in RuntimeAdapter had shared abort_event and global_abort_event overwritten on every new mission start, creating cross-mission cancellation leaks.

isolation_solution.agent_loop_scoping: Instantiate scoped AgentLoop per mission run rather than mutating shared runtime.agent_loop

stop.semantics: Immediately trigger abort_event, terminate mission-owned subprocesses, cancel background asyncio.Task, invalidate pending approval requests, and publish MISSION_CANCELLED.

pause.semantics: Clear pause_event, suspend agent loop iteration before turn execution begins, preserve all files, memory, and task state intact, publish MISSION_PAUSED.

resume.semantics: Set pause_event, verify resume eligibility, resume turn execution from exact paused state, publish MISSION_RESUMED.
resume.eligibility: Allowed only for non-terminal, paused missions in the active session. Cold restart or cross-process resume deferred to Phase 2/3 durable checkpoints.

cancel.semantics: Authoritative user/system termination marking run as terminal, releasing locks, and preventing any late model or tool transitions from altering state.
